description: Build an X-Robots-Tag response-header value from flag directives (noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet, notranslate, noimageindex, none, all, indexifembedded) plus optional max-snippet, max-image-preview, max-video-preview, and unavailable_after value directives, per Google's documented robots directive syntax. Optionally scope the header to a single crawler with userAgent (e.g. "googlebot").

maxImagePreview.description: Max image preview size shown in search results

maxSnippet.description: Max text snippet length in characters; 0 shows no snippet, -1 means no limit

maxVideoPreview.description: Max video preview length in seconds; 0 shows no preview, -1 means no limit

unavailableAfter.description: Stop showing this page in search results after this date/time

userAgent.description: Optional crawler name to scope the header to, e.g. "googlebot"

name: build_x_robots_tag
